claims.label: thm:minimal-contact
claims.claim: All derivative contact polynomials at minimally compensated negative even orders.
claims.scope: Analytic proof, with complete cutoff-coordinate dependence.

claims.label: thm:filter-all
claims.claim: Periodic mean is the only all-derivative critical contact obstruction.
claims.scope: Generally conditional convergence; horizontal differences improve to absolute convergence.

claims.label: thm:modular
claims.claim: Order-dependent contour transformation and all finite derivative corrections.
claims.scope: Horizontal shift a=1; neighborhoods of nonpositive even orders and order one. Classical zeroth derivatives are credited.

claims.label: mtp:generator
claims.claim: Arbitrary mixed even-order regular moments, anchored generators, finite MZV spans.
claims.scope: Does not prove general optimal unequal bilinear prefix conjecture.
claims.predecessor_target: Bernoulli Tails unequal products of three or more factors

claims.label: mtp:short-cubic
claims.scope: Two proofs, including finite exact Laurent-polynomial telescoper.
claims.predecessor_target: New consequence relative to inspected corpus

claims.label: mtp:short-quartic
claims.claim: Ordinary mixed quartic-cubic combination has a weight-seven zeta-product evaluation.
claims.scope: Absolutely convergent; the weight-nine anchor cancels.
claims.predecessor_target: New consequence relative to inspected corpus

claims.label: mtp:triple
claims.claim: Six- and eight-coordinate exact reconstruction for the mixed cubic and quartic.
claims.scope: Formal-coordinate rank; no arithmetic independence assertion.

claims.label: gs:completed
claims.claim: Explicit jointly holomorphic independent-shift product generator.
claims.scope: Geometrically convergent Hurwitz series, not a generic finite classical alphabet reduction.
claims.predecessor_target: Tail Kernels R8 resolved in the explicit convergent class

claims.label: gs:gamma1-digamma
claims.claim: Explicit gamma_1 times digamma integral with harmonic numbers, dilogarithms and zeta derivatives.
claims.scope: Positive shifts; admissible finite prefixes ensure geometric convergence.
claims.predecessor_target: New specialization of the completed generator

claims.label: sfj:thm:monomial
claims.claim: Every polynomial face coefficient in finite harmonic-star form.
claims.scope: Gamma-normalized logarithmic moments also follow from a rational compiler.

claims.label: sfj:thm:gamma-polylog
claims.claim: Every Gamma face with one displaced mass is a depth-two polylogarithm lattice.
claims.scope: a>0, B>=0, delta>=0, k>=2; k=2 recovers the credited known covariance.

claims.label: sfj:thm:pole
claims.claim: Complete polar numerator and joint holomorphy criterion for quadratic products.
claims.scope: Unequal masses: even polynomial W, unless a zero-mean periodic multiplier cancels the pole.

claims.label: sfj:cor:squarefree
claims.claim: Holomorphic mixed defect and simplified squarefree mixed derivatives.
claims.scope: Requires the explicitly prescribed local rational subtraction.
